summary:
SiteLens Design System v1.1 Implementation Plan:
1. Brand Identity: Bespoke geometric folded S ribbon aperture logo mark in Geo Purple (#7C5CFF to #A78BFA).
2. Workspace Architecture: Full-bleed MapLibre canvas with floating glassmorphic HUD components (top bar, CAD tool dock, right inspector drawer, bottom telemetry pill).
3. Topographic Intelligence: Elevation contour line visualization and hypsometric tinting layers inspired by Kepler.gl with dynamic color scales and legend.
4. Typography & Tokens: Inter + Manrope typography, zero-pill discipline, tabular numerals, dark-first with complete light mode support.
5. Geodetic Preservation: Maintain 100% ellipsoidal GIS precision, CAD interaction lifecycle, undo/redo, and persistence.
